entities.name: UserConsumerWebMobile
entities.rationale: Mobile phone and desktop icons at left; client devices that call API Gateway and fetch content from CloudFront; receive playlist back.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled CLOUDFRONT at top-left; serves content from S3 to clients.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Red icon labeled API GATEWAY; receives requests from client devices.

entities.name: Lambda (API handler)
entities.rationale: Small orange Lambda icon right of API Gateway; sends messages to SQS queues and returns playlist to client.

entities.name: SQS (top queues)
entities.rationale: Two overlapping pink SQS icons labeled SQS at top center; fed by Lambda and connected to EC2 Auto Scaling group.

entities.name: SQS (bottom queue)
entities.rationale: Single pink SQS icon labeled SQS below the first; fed by Lambda and connected to EC2 Auto Scaling group.

entities.name: EC2 Auto Scaling
entities.rationale: Orange auto scaling icon inside the orange box labeled EC2 AUTO SCALING; container box also holds the EC2 instances icon.

entities.name: EC2 Instances
entities.rationale: White/orange EC2 instances icon drawn inside the orange EC2 AUTO SCALING box, alongside the Auto Scaling icon.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket labeled S3 at top right; receives output from EC2 Auto Scaling group and is the origin for CloudFront.

entities.name: Lambda (Step Functions)
entities.rationale: Orange Lambda icon above Step Functions; invoked by Step Functions, acts on the EC2 Auto Scaling group and points to CloudWatch.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Pink icon labeled STEP FUNCTIONS at bottom center; orchestrates the Lambda above it.

entities.name: Lambda (CloudWatch Events)
entities.rationale: Orange Lambda icon above CloudWatch Events; triggered by CloudWatch Events and acts on the EC2 Auto Scaling group.

entities.name: CloudWatch Events
entities.rationale: Pink CloudWatch icon labeled CLOUDWATCH EVENTS at bottom right, with a small scheduled metrics/alarm icon attached at its top-right corner; receives metrics from the Auto Scaling group.

visual_connections.description: Green arrow from client devices to API Gateway.
Green arrow from API Gateway to the Lambda.
Green arrow from Lambda up to the top SQS queues.
Green arrow from Lambda down to the bottom SQS queue.
Curved green arrow labeled 'playlist' going back from the Lambda/API area to the client devices.
Green arrow from the EC2 Auto Scaling box pointing to the top SQS queues (instances polling the queue).
Green arrow from the EC2 Auto Scaling box pointing to the bottom SQS queue (instances polling the queue).
Curved green arrow from the EC2 Auto Scaling box up to the S3 bucket.
Long curved green arrow labeled 'RaaS' from S3 to CloudFront.
Curved green arrow from client devices up to CloudFront.
Curved green arrow from Step Functions up to the Lambda above it.
Green arrow from the Lambda up to the EC2 Auto Scaling box.
Green arrow from the Lambda diagonally down to CloudWatch.
Green arrow from the EC2 Auto Scaling box down to CloudWatch (metrics).
Curved green arrow from the CloudWatch Events scheduled icon up to the Lambda.
Green arrow from the Lambda up to the EC2 Auto Scaling box.
